note: Owner pre-decided all 9 governing questions (TODO.md §6.0); decisions firm. Mechanism details tagged [assumed]. Grounded in a full live-code read 2026-05-31 (baseline 361 tests pass). Line numbers indicative — executor confirms against live files. DELTA 2026-07-11: reconciled with owner-labeled ground truth (rubric v2 + tests/fixtures/dedup_traps.yaml, 30 piles/60 events); 5 requirements added (0.14, 2.11, 2.12, 3.12, 3.13), 6 modified (0.9, 2.3, 2.4, 2.5, 3.3, 3.10); universal kinetic floor replaced by Poland-only floor. Round-2 (same day, post-adversarial): added 0.15, 3.14; modified 4.5 (fire-first covers natively-scored 9s), 2.5 (geo-LOW demotes to NOTIFY never NONE), 2.5b/2.11 (debris carve-out), 3.12 (reaction detection pinned to official_statement), 3.13 (loop must not author frozen file); dedup_traps_frozen.yaml removed from owned_files (owner-generated). Round-3: blocking fix to 3.12 roundup signal (open-event qualifier removed - failed pile-03 E2); 4.5 scoped to NEW-event resolution (no dup re-fire); 3.14 hit semantics pinned (CALL AlertIntent during stateful replay); added 2.13 (config-driven pre-event gate, corroborator._MIN_EVENT_URGENCY fact) + 2.14 (Polish rendering for all event_type values); 0.15 adds is_military_event:true rule; 3.8 made symmetric. Round-4: 2.6 first-CALL-per-event semantics (ESCALATION to a CALL-alerted event = NOTIFY; an event's first CALL-class intent always fires, regardless of relation - closes the sms-alerted-event-escalates-to-10 hole); 4.5 fire-first extended to call-tier-crossing ESCALATIONs; 2.13 deterministic is_military_event exemption for the 0.15 types; test wording reconciliations.

phases.title: Alerting reliability (durable failure records + bounded retry)
Single AlertPolicy + GeoWeighter (decision consolidation; remove corroboration)

requirements.statement: Add Romania to monitoring.target_countries as {code: RO, name: Romania, name_native: Rumunia}.
Add geography.high_tier_countries containing PL,LT,LV,EE,RO (RO HIGH-eligible).
No hardcoded city/town/gazetteer; country resolution stays LLM-driven country-level.
Add Romanian-language source(s)/keywords.
Prompt target-country gate: unnamed 'a NATO country' must not resolve to Poland/a specific monitored country unless named.

Revise the 'EXCLUSIVELY PL/LT/LV/EE' (L142) + 'non-monitored=1-3' (L143-144) clauses: monitored=PL/LT/LV/EE/RO are 9-10 eligible; non-monitored NATO not auto-9; NATO-attack-on-Russia HIGH; scope line (L14-15) includes Romania.
Demote R4 POLAND PRIORITY (L57-59) to a confirmed-PL tie-break; must not promote non-PL to PL.
Preserve (not weaken) explicit-country-only + physical-location rules (L34-37, L145-146); spillover affects urgency only.

Preserve inside-Ukraine = LOW (~2, rubric v2; monitored-country reaction is a separate event); ADD Ukrainian-attack-inside-Russia = LOW (~1) except NATO-attacks-Russia HIGH (0.6). (MODIFIED 2026-07-11; previously 'urgency 1-3'.)
Set config.testing.eval_set_file to eval_set_human.yaml (owner gate).
Add testing.regression_eval_set_file (=eval_set.yaml) wired as a non-gating regression run.
Must not modify/pre-fill/bootstrap labels in either eval fixture; owner is sole labeler.
Add 'RO' to harness.MONITORED_COUNTRIES so RO/9 maps to phone_call in eval.

Classifier prompt encodes the rubric-v2 geography ladder (PL direct attack 9-10; live intrusion over PL >=9; PL debris 8; Baltics minor 6-7/strike 8/deliberate w-casualties 9; Romania minor 6/injuries 7-8/massive 9; Moldova ~6; roundup/reaction stories scored on own weight). (ADDED 2026-07-11.)

classifier event_type enum gains debris_found (PL debris scored 8 per 0.14) and official_statement (reaction story; scored per reaction rule) with prompt rules, INCLUDING: such stories about military matters keep is_military_event:true (else the pre-event filter drops them, see 2.13). Carve-out signals for 2.5b/2.11/3.12. (ADDED round-2; is_military_event rule round-3.)
Persist a failed send as an alert_records row status='failed' with non-null error_code (not only a log line).
Bound cross-cycle phone-retry rounds by config alerts.retry.max_rounds against a durable per-event counter events.alert_round_count; terminal status (failed_terminal) at cap; not in-memory.
Failed primary send must not silently drop the alert; recorded + retried up to cap.
Twilio/push clients MUST return a structured failure result (replacing bare None) carrying error code/detail; all 'if record is None' call sites updated so the failure record (1.1) captures it.
_confirmation_code/_confirmation_sms_sid scoped per-event.
All retry/cap values from config; none hardcoded.
alert_records schema change migrates existing rows without data loss (additive columns).

AlertPolicy is the single decision authority; the THREE old decision sites (corroborator._determine_alert_status, state_machine._determine_action, harness._action_for_urgency) are deleted or delegate.

Corroboration removed; no source-count gate may suppress/delay. Remove the full surface: both YAML keys, both Pydantic fields (ClassificationConfig.corroboration_required default 2, UrgencyLevel.corroboration_required), and the tests/conftest.py key — config still loads cleanly.

Dedup is the only suppressor of alert-eligible events (urgency >= notify threshold): no-alert only when relation==SAME on an already-alerted event. NONE-band (<=4) is banding via 2.4, not suppression. (MODIFIED 2026-07-11.)

Three bands (rubric v2): >=call-tier (9-10) -> CALL; 5-8 -> NOTIFY; <=4 -> NONE (classification persisted and logged, no alert; no event row required - see 2.13). Boundaries config-driven. (MODIFIED 2026-07-11; wording reconciled with the pre-event gate round-3.)

GeoWeighter computes geo_tier (HIGH if target in high_tier_countries OR target==RU & attacker_is_nato; LOW for inside-UA/interior-MD); CALL requires urgency>=tier AND geo HIGH; urgency>=call-tier with geo LOW demotes to NOTIFY, never NONE. (MODIFIED 2026-07-11: universal kinetic floor REMOVED, replaced by Poland-only floor 2.11; demotion rule added round-2.)
UNKNOWN geo at urgency>=9 treated as HIGH (fail toward firing).

kinetic derived deterministically from event_type against config-driven geography.kinetic_event_types (not a new LLM field, not hardcoded); default set MUST NOT include debris_found or official_statement (0.15); single definition consumed by 2.5/2.11 and 3.8. (MODIFIED 2026-07-11 round-2: debris/statement carve-out.)

NEW at CALL tier fires a call. ESCALATION/UPDATE to an event already alerted at CALL class uses NOTIFY, not a second call. An event's FIRST CALL-class intent MUST fire regardless of relation (NEW or ESCALATION; SAME cannot carry a tier crossing per 3.7 - on defective input fail toward firing). 'Alerted at CALL class' = a CALL intent was DISPATCHED, regardless of transport outcome (delivery failure handled by 1.2 retries, never by re-deciding policy). (MODIFIED rounds 4 + post-PASS hardening.)
Decision is channel-agnostic; AlertIntent carries a channel class; transports pluggable and preserved.
All thresholds + geography membership in config; none hardcoded.

AlertPolicy.decide is a pure no-I/O function of EventDecision, weighted urgency, geo_tier, and the event's prior alert class (already_alerted_at: ChannelClass|None, needed by 2.6). (Hardened post-PASS.)
Defines EventDecision contract (relation NEW|SAME|ESCALATION + matched_event_id) as the Phase 3 interface.

Poland-only kinetic floor: kinetic (2.5b) + target==PL -> urgency floored >=9; MUST NOT floor other HIGH-tier countries; debris-recovery reports never floored (excluded from kinetic via 0.15 debris_found); config geography.floor_countries default [PL]. (ADDED 2026-07-11; refined round-2.)
AlertPolicy band mapping reproduces the owner's action from the owner's urgency for all 60 labeled events in dedup_traps.yaml (call->CALL, sms->NOTIFY, none->NONE). (ADDED 2026-07-11.)

Pre-dedup event-creation gate (hardcoded corroborator._MIN_EVENT_URGENCY=5 + is_military_event drop, corroborator.py:28,53) becomes config-driven (dedup.min_event_urgency [assumed]) and MUST NOT drop official_statement/roundup stories reaching the notify band; the is_military_event drop MUST NOT apply to debris_found/official_statement articles (deterministic exemption - prompt compliance alone is not a gate); NONE-band articles keep persisted classification, no event row. (ADDED round-3; exemption round-4.)

Every classifier event_type value (incl. debris_found, official_statement) has a Polish rendering in alert templates (extend state_machine.EVENT_TYPE_PL L16-27 or move to config) - alerts are in Polish, no raw English token fallback. (ADDED 2026-07-11 round-3.)
EventDeduplicator.decide replaces corroborator._find_matching_event grouping and emits EventDecision (article-level deduplicator.py untouched).
Ambiguous same/new defaults to NEW, never SAME.
Split driven by concrete signals (geo_id, tier-cross, time gap), not wording variants of the same incident; roundup/meta stories are NOT wording variants - own event per 3.12. (MODIFIED 2026-07-11.)
geo_id normalization collapses cross-language place refs (Galati variants) via transliteration, no town list.
Higher-or-equal-urgency new event at same place must not be a silent SAME (no attach-and-silence); sub-critical->critical surfaces as ESCALATION/NEW.
Strike on monitored soil while another event open -> NEW + CALL re-eval (RO-open->PL-strike).
Dedup must not suppress across a different geo_id or across the CALL-tier boundary.

Kinetic and non-kinetic events MUST NOT merge in EITHER direction (kinetic strike never into airspace event; debris_found never into an open kinetic event), same geography.kinetic_event_types definition as 2.5b. (MODIFIED 2026-07-11 round-3: made symmetric.)
Deduplicator MAY use the already-emitted is_new_event as a NEW-direction (split) signal only; MUST NOT use it as a merge-toward-prior signal.
Deterministic core does no network/LLM I/O; fully unit-testable.

dedup_traps.yaml EXISTS (owner-labeled, 2026-07-11, 30 piles/60 events, rubric v2): read-only input - MUST NOT create/modify/regenerate/extend; piles 33-62 are a sealed reserve, never added or requested. RO-open->PL-strike is not in the fixture (covered by 3.6 unit test). (MODIFIED 2026-07-11; previously 'create blank-label fixture'.)
All dedup windows/thresholds/normalization in config; none hardcoded.

Roundup/summary and politician-reaction stories form their OWN event, never merged into an incident event, never bridge two incidents. Detection: roundups = story referencing >=2 distinct geo_ids WHETHER OR NOT each locus has an open event (wrong split = warn-only under-merge); reactions = event_type==official_statement (0.15). Mechanism MUST reproduce all three cited roundup examples (pile-03 E2 incl. the no-open-event locus, pile-17 E3, pile-21 E3) on standalone replay. (ADDED 2026-07-11; open-event qualifier removed round-3 - it provably failed pile-03 E2.)

Behavioral trap gate replays FROZEN per-article classifier outputs from tests/fixtures/dedup_traps_frozen.yaml (owner-run ./run.sh --freeze-traps generates it; gates never call live LLMs; missing coverage skips with reported count). The loop MUST NOT author, fabricate, or commit any dedup_traps_frozen.yaml content - tooling and schema only. (ADDED 2026-07-11; no-author clause round-2.)

9/10 recall gate: for every owner-labeled call event in a frozen-covered pile, replay (frozen outputs -> GeoWeighter -> AlertPolicy) MUST route to CALL; a hit = at least one of that owner event's stories produces a CALL-class AlertIntent during STATEFUL replay (GeoWeighter-score-only assertions do not count); zero misses among covered piles; skip semantics per 3.13. (ADDED round-2; hit semantics pinned round-3.)
Embedding model runs locally; no hosted embedding API in the dedup path.
Embeddings fail-open: failed embed -> NEW (fire), never suppression.
Embedding similarity only in the ambiguous band; Phase 3 deterministic hard overrides not overruled.
Sonnet 4.6 judge invoked only when urgency>=9 on either side.

For any article the deterministic core resolves as opening a NEW event at call tier (weighted urgency >= call tier, geo HIGH - floored or natively scored) OR as producing an event's first CALL-class intent via a call-tier-crossing ESCALATION (2.6), the CALL fires first (synchronously); judge async, may only suppress a later duplicate, never gates/delays the first call; duplicates of a CALL-alerted event governed by 2.6. (MODIFIED rounds 2-4.)
Judge fails-open on timeout/429/error -> NEW + CALL under config judge_timeout_seconds.
Classification stays Haiku 4.5; only the dedup judge escalates to Sonnet 4.6.
Embedding/judge model ids, trigger, band thresholds, judge_timeout_seconds, Tier-2 toggle in config; none hardcoded.
Embedding model is a lightweight quantized multilingual model suited to the VPS; exact choice tuned against the over-merge eval.
Embedding/judge tests hermetic (mock model + API); real-model/API tests marked non-gating (integration).
